title: bug: create_team's name+role idempotency looks up the untrimmed name but stores the trimmed one, so a space-padded --team value mints a new same-named team on every seat launch instead of returning the existing team
description:
Filed by defect hunt #9 (task-66961b32), lane: daemon team tool family. All paths are under packages/moe-daemon/ unless noted.

PROBLEM
- The contract, src/tools/createTeam.ts:11: "Create a team or return existing team with same name+role (idempotent)".
- The lookup uses the raw name: createTeam.ts:57-58 calls state.getTeamByNameAndRole(params.name, ...).
- The store saves the trimmed name: state.createTeam calls validateTeamName (src/state/validators.ts:651-655, trim: true).
- So "Coders " never matches the "Coders" team it created, and every call creates another team with the same name and role.
- Who calls it: the wrappers, on every seat launch and before each claim while the seat is unjoined. They pass --team verbatim: scripts/moe-agent.sh:408-409 sets TEAM="$2", and :2110-2115 sends json.dumps({'name': TEAM}). TOOL_AUDIENCE is [] (src/tools/index.ts:227), so only wrappers and governors call it.
- Impact: with a padded value, each launch creates and joins its own "Coders" team. The fleet splits into one-seat teams and claim_next_task's team sharing is lost; per scripts/moe-agent.sh:2141-2144, a seat without a shared team skips every epic a live worker holds.

EVIDENCE (HEAD 39bec237, run in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout)
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-66961b32/A/zzHuntA_createTeamTrim.test.ts, with its output in .out.txt beside it. The architect re-ran it in /tmp/hunt-6696-snap (verify-architect.txt). Tests 2 failed (2):
  - two create_team {name:'Coders '} calls: received sameId false, secondCreated true, teams ["Coders|null","Coders|null"];
  - create_team {name:' Gov', role:'governor'} after {name:'Gov', role:'governor'}: received created true, sameId false.

FIX DIRECTION
- Normalize the name once before the lookup, e.g. `const name = validateTeamName(params.name)`, and use that value for both getTeamByNameAndRole and state.createTeam.
- Keep missingRequired for an absent name, and keep the existing INVALID_INPUT for a bad type or a name that is blank after trim.

FILES
- src/tools/createTeam.ts
- src/tools/createTeam.test.ts
definitionOfDone: In src/tools/createTeam.test.ts, two create_team {name:'Coders '} calls return the same team id. The second returns created: false, state.teams.size is 1, and the stored name is 'Coders'.

implementationPlan.description:
Fix packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/createTeam.ts, editing with your own editing tool.

- Add `import { validateTeamName } from '../state/validators.js';`. It is the exact normalizer the store applies, through teamStore createTeam -> validateCreateTeamInput (src/state/validators.ts:651-655 and :686-695: trim plus string, empty, control-character and 200-char checks).
- Directly after the maxSize check and before the idempotency lookup, compute `const name = validateTeamName(params.name);`. Use `name` in BOTH getTeamByNameAndRole branches (:57-58) and in state.createTeam({ name, role, maxSize }).
- Add a short comment above it: the store trims the name, so the lookup must compare the same normalized value; otherwise 'Coders ' never matches the 'Coders' team it created and every wrapper launch mints a duplicate.

Error handling:
- Keep `if (!params.name) throw missingRequired('name')` first, and keep the role and maxSize checks in their current order, so a payload with several errors reports the same first refusal as today.
- validateTeamName throws INVALID_INPUT for a non-string, a name that is blank after trim, a control character or more than 200 chars. Those are the same refusals state.createTeam already raised; they now fire before the lookup, and nothing is written on any refusal.

Change nothing else: not the workerId strip, the response shape {team, created}, getTeamByNameAndRole in teamStore.ts, the /ws CREATE_TEAM handler or any docs. The tool description already promises the idempotency.
implementationPlan.note: Normalize via validateTeamName after the maxSize check; used in both lookups and createTeam.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: moe.create_team normalizes the team name once with validateTeamName (the store's own trim and validation) before its name+role idempotency lookup. A space-padded name then returns the existing team with created:false instead of minting a duplicate. Every refusal (MISSING_REQUIRED for an absent or empty name, INVALID_INPUT for a bad role, maxSize or name) keeps its code, and nothing is written on a refusal.
acceptanceCriteria: Two create_team {name:'Coders '} calls return the same team id; the second has created:false, teams.size is 1, and the stored name is 'Coders'.
create_team {name:' Gov', role:'governor'} after {name:'Gov', role:'governor'} returns created:false with the first id, while a roleless {name:' Gov '} still creates a separate team.
The createTeam.test.ts and joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts gate passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.
invariants: A null-role create never adopts a role-bound team with the same name (createTeam.ts:50-55).
Stored team names stay exactly what validateTeamName returns.
No team is created or written on any refusal.
compatibility: The response shape {team, created} is unchanged; the refusal codes MISSING_REQUIRED and INVALID_INPUT are unchanged.
The wrappers' create_team calls (scripts/moe-agent.sh:2110-2115) need no change.
Existing .moe/teams records are unaffected: every stored name was already trimmed by the store.
approvedScope: createTeamTool handler in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/createTeam.ts (name normalization before the lookup, plus one import)
reuse: validateTeamName (packages/moe-daemon/src/state/validators.ts), the same normalizer state.createTeam applies through validateCreateTeamInput.
sourceAssumptions: createTeam.ts:56-58 looks up getTeamByNameAndRole(params.name, ...) with the raw name.
teamStore.ts:31-36 getTeamByNameAndRole compares team.name === name exactly.
validators.ts:651-655 validateTeamName uses trim:true with maxLength 200; validators.ts:686-695 validateCreateTeamInput applies it on create.

approachesConsidered: Trimming inside teamStore.getTeamByNameAndRole was rejected: it changes a shared lookup and hides the mismatch rather than fixing the caller.
An inline params.name.trim() was rejected: it duplicates validateTeamName and would drift from the store's control-character and length rules.
Trimming --team in the wrappers was rejected: every caller would need it, while the daemon owns the idempotency contract.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: The store already trims through validateCreateTeamInput, and only the tool's lookup compares the raw value. Calling the same validator earlier fixes the mismatch and keeps every refusal identical, only earlier. The architect dry-ran red at base (t1 and t2 fail, t3 passes) and green with the fix (14/14) in a scratch snapshot.
risks: The order of refusals: keep missingRequired first and the role and maxSize checks before the normalization, so a payload with several errors reports the same first error.
Do not touch /ws CREATE_TEAM (WebSocketServer.ts:837, which no client sends) or docs; the description already promises idempotency.

A space-padded name returns the existing team with created:false. Added t1-t3 in createTeam.test.ts (red on base: t1,t2 fail, t3 passes; green with fix). Refusal codes unchanged; nothing written on refusal.
